basic_details.job_title: MRVC Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) is recruiting candidates for 3 vacancies, including Assistant Manager (Electrical) and Assistant Manager (S&T). Eligible candidates can apply offline by sending their applications through ordinary post and email to DGM(HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd., 2nd Floor, Churchgate Station Building, Mumbai on or before 12 November 2026. Applicants for Assistant Manager (Electrical) require a Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, while Assistant Manager (S&T) applicants need a Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Telecommun

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 35 years as on the date of issue of vacancy notification. The upper age should not exceed 35 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
qualification.details: Assistant Manager (Electrical): Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Working in the field of Electrical Engineering, specifically in Overhead Equipment (OHE) / Power Supply Installations, in Indian Railways, Railway PSUs, RRTS or Metro Rail organizations, with specific CDA/IDA grade service requirements. Assistant Manager (S&T): Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunication/Electronics & Communication Engineering from recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Working in the field of Signal & Telecommunication Engineering, specifically in Signaling and/or Telecommunications, in Indian Railways, Railway PSUs, RRTS or Metro Rail organizations, with specific CDA/IDA grade service requirements.

selection_process: Preliminary screening of applications received by mail and post Shortlisting of eligible candidates up to 5 times the notified vacancies Personal Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MRVC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.mrvc.indianrailways.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Manager (Electrical): Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Working in the field of Electrical Engineering, specifically in Overhead Equipment (OHE) / Power Supply Installations, in Indian Railways, Railway PSUs, RRTS or Metro Rail organizations, with specific CDA/IDA grade service requirements. Assistant Manager (S&T): Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunication/Electronics & Communication Engineering from recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA. Working in the field of Signal & Telecommunication Engineering, specifically in Signaling and/or Telecommunications, in Indian Railways, Railway PSUs, RRTS or Metro Rail organizations, with specific CDA/IDA grade service requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MRVC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.mrvc.indianrailways.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) for filling up various executive level engineering positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in MRVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Assistant Manager (Electrical) and Assistant Manager (S&T) under the regular direct recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced across Assistant Manager (Electrical) and Assistant Manager (S&T) positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full Time B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Telecommunication/Electronics & Communication Engineering from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications through ordinary post and email is 12 November 2026 up to 17:30 hours.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary scale for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in the IDA E2 scale of Rs. 50,000 - 1,60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all posts is 35 years as on the date of issue of the vacancy notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates need to send their filled applications via ordinary post and email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises preliminary screening of applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates up to 5 times vacancies, and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to DGM(HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd., 2nd Floor, Churchgate Station Building, Mumbai-400020 and emailed to [email protected].
